QuestInfo.name: Looking for a House
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p230# of #m10001007# has something more to tell me about houses.
QuestInfo.1: #p230# of #m10001007# suggested that if I want to get a house, I should go see #b#p231##k. I should be able to find #p231# on the east side of #m10001000#.
QuestInfo.2: It seems I can buy a house from #p231# of #m10001000#. I'll have to remember that.

0.0: But how can you get such a nice house, you ask? Heh heh, you're an eager one, aren't you? Honestly, #b#p231##k could answer that faster than I can. Care to go meet her?

yes.0: Excellent! Just head east after leaving #m10001007# and you'll run into #b#p231##k before long.
yes.1: Well, that's about all I can tell you. If you have any more questions, feel free to ask me anytime. We also sell all sorts of house-related items here at #m10001007#, so drop by often!

no.0: Looks like you're busy at the moment. Still, I'd really suggest meeting her when you have some time.

1.0: Hello! I'm showing cozy houses to everyone who's recently become a resident of #m10001000#. It looks like you've already met #p230#... right? Hehe, then this should go quickly.
1.1: Residents of #m10001000# whose Citizenship Grade is #rVisitor#k or higher can purchase a house through me. We want as many people as possible to have a home, so we're offering them at a specially low price. No need to worry about the cost!
1.2: Still, you can't buy a house without even seeing what it looks like, can you? You're welcome to tour the house I'm offering, so look around as much as you like, and if you love it, you can buy it.
1.3: Once you buy a house, a portal will appear at the entrance of the mushroom house behind me, and you'll be able to enter #h0#'s house through it anytime. You can use the #r#p237##k inside to manage and decorate your home, so be sure to check it out.
1.4: Lastly, you can use the #r#p236##k beside me to visit your neighbors' houses. Just keep in mind that you can only enter houses that allow visitors.
1.5: Oh, that was a long explanation. Well then, it's time to get yourself a house! If you'd like to buy one, or want to know more about houses, just talk to me anytime!

npc.0: If you want to buy a house, be sure to go see #b#p231##k to the east of #m10001000#!
